name: Super Sour Raz Apple Chews | 200mg
description:
Pucker up Michigan! Choice Chew's Super Sour Raz Apple hybrid gummies are juicy blast of sour and sweet! This tongue-twisting new flavor will test your will power and have you coming back for more. 

Made from scratch and infused with premium, high potency distillate it's no wonder that Choice Chew's are a Michigan favorite!
